page.title: Brass curtain ring, set of 8 before you pay

product.name: Brass curtain ring, set of 8
product.description: A little cedar from the cupboard shows up in this run, and a soft cloth keeps the brass bright, batch copper drawer sixty.

blocks.text: A Sunday evening fill at a wash house put brass rings into a paper band, batch oak crate twenty nine.
Batch cedar pail forty two names a wash house and mentions hand hemming.
Pallet share six dollars and thirty three cents
Nothing in the pack beyond brass rings, filled at the cutting table on a market morning, batch maple crock seventy three.
A hemmer on the day shift signed the slip Sunday evening because the brass stays bright, batch cork stall sixteen.
